reserves.name: Wrapped tokenized U.S. Treasury bill and RWA partner basket
reserves.issuerOrObligor: Qualified Solayer liquidity providers and undisclosed RWA issuers

sources.label: Solayer sUSD subscription and redemption process

reserveReview.rationale: Solayer documents that qualified liquidity providers exchange deposited USDC for wrapped T-bill assets, which the sUSD program locks before minting sUSD at a one-to-one value. The docs permit a broader low-risk RWA basket but do not identify current products or weights, so the reserve remains one structured aggregate slice. Write-time re-open 2026-07-28: Solayer transparency&security docs still describe market-maker PDAs holding TBILL balances on Solana; litepaper/process docs remain structural. No public weight split of TBILL vs other → ku=100 retained.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Solayer wrapped-T-bill RFQ mint and redemption architecture
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The current RWA issuers, instruments, maturity profile, and liquidity-provider allocation are not disclosed.

providers.name: Solayer sUSD program and market-maker PDAs

custodyProfile.uncertainty: Solayer states that isolated program-derived accounts hold each market maker's wrapped T-bill balance, but does not identify the RWA custodians, market-maker shares, bankruptcy-remoteness terms, or rehypothecation policy.
